title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: breakout room support
summary: Hold: Microsoft Learn now lists Android breakout room participation as Available, contrary to the briefing. Release notes also describe the feature in the November 2026 Android app update, so the claims that its behaviour and app version are unpublished need correcting while retaining the roadmap and Message Center targets.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans breakout room support for Teams Rooms on Android.
claims.quote: With breakout room support, Teams Rooms on Android can be added to a breakout room and moved in and out of the main room making it easy for breakout session coordination.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn has no page describing the Android feature's new behaviour itself.
claims.quote:
### 1449/1.0.96.2026344105 (November 2026)
Introduced in this update:
- **Breakout rooms support:** Teams Rooms on Android devices can join a breakout room, allowing in-room participants to stay with their group.
claims.fix: Replace the no-Learn-description sentence with: 'Microsoft Learn release notes describe breakout room support in the November 2026 Android update 1449/1.0.96.2026344105: devices can join a breakout room, allowing in-room participants to stay with their group.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/rooms-release-note.
